logger.message: #[%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { fecha: now() as String {format: "dd-MM-yyyy HH:mm:ss a"}, level: p('system.log.level') default "INFO", environment: vars.env, apiName: app.name, flow: flow.name, correlationId: vars.correlationId, httpMethod: attributes.method, uriParam: if (!isEmpty(attributes.uriParams)) attributes.uriParams[0] else null, message: "Initiating orders " ++ attributes.method ++ " request to database", }]

db:select.db:sql: SELECT * FROM orders WHERE (:id IS NULL OR order_id = :id) AND (:userId IS NULL OR user_id = :userId)
db:select.db:input-parameters: #[%dw 2.0 output application/java --- { id: attributes.uriParams.orderId default null, userId: attributes.queryParams.userId }]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- if (isEmpty(payload)) { "message": "Register not founded", "status": "Fail" } else payload

logger.message: #[%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { fecha: now() as String {format: "dd-MM-yyyy HH:mm:ss a"}, level: p('system.log.level') default "INFO", environment: vars.env, apiName: app.name, flow: flow.name, correlationId: vars.correlationId, httpMethod: vars.saveMethod, details:{ message: "Order successfully get into database.", affected_rows: payload.affectedRows default 1, } }]
